articles.title: Rubio says US not 'under systemic attack' after series of tech outages
articles.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said there was "zero evidence" supporting theories online that recent disruptions affecting Microsoft, banks and flights are connected.

articles.title: American soldier arrested by UK police on suspicion of spying taken into US military custody
